title: UbuntuGuard signed policy envelope, version 1
description: Transport wrapper for a signed policy. The payload travels base64-encoded so that no JSON layer between the signer and the verifier can reorder or re-escape the signed bytes. The agent MUST verify the Ed25519 signature over the decoded payload bytes BEFORE parsing them. See docs/02-policy-and-signing.md for the normative signing input.

envelope_version.description: Bumped only for breaking envelope changes.

policy_version.description: Strictly increasing per (policy_type, scope). The agent rejects any version that is not greater than the last applied version, which is what blocks downgrade and replay.

id.description: Device UUID for kind=device, group id for kind=group, the literal 'all' for kind=fleet. The agent rejects an envelope whose scope does not resolve to itself.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Rejected if more than 300 s in the future.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC or null for no expiry. Rejected if more than 300 s in the past.

payload_b64.description: Standard base64 (RFC 4648 §4) of the exact signed payload bytes. Decoded size is capped at 64 KiB.

payload_sha256.description: ADVISORY ONLY. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the decoded payload bytes, for display, logs and dedupe. It is deliberately NOT part of the signing input; the agent recomputes it and fails closed on mismatch, but authenticity rests solely on the signature.

key_id.description: 'ed25519:' followed by the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over the raw 32-byte public key. The agent rejects a key_id that is not in its pinned trust set.

value_b64.description: Base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over SIG_INPUT.
